function.name: cmd_controller_execute
function.description: Executes a system-level command using os.system() on Windows operating systems. It can execute single or multiple commands chained with '&&'. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

command.description: The system command to be executed. To execute multiple commands, separate them with '&&'. For example, 'dir && echo done'.

unit.description: Specifies the unit of measure for the command if applicable. This is not utilized by os.system() directly but can be used for logging or analysis purposes.

message.content:
I don’t have a way to capture the output of a command from here, so I can’t tell you directly whether a VPN client is installed.  
However, you can run a quick check yourself. Open a **Command Prompt** (or PowerShell) and execute one of the following:

```cmd
:: Using WMIC (works on most Windows versions)
wmic product where "name like '%VPN%'" get Name
```

or

```powershell
:: Using PowerShell
Get-WmiObject -Class Win32_Product | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'VPN' } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name
```

If any VPN software is installed, its name(s) will be listed. If nothing appears, no VPN client matching “VPN” in its name is present.
